title: butterfly
summary: Composes a symbol's callers (upward wing) and callees (downward wing) into one combined chart in a single command

surfaces.usage: drag-lint butterfly --qname <X> [--depth N] [--format dot|mermaid|text|json] [--output F] --db PATH [--db ...] (composes callers (upward wing) + callees (downward wing) of X into one chart; default format dot)
